title: AI assistant
body_text: To assist you in performing the tasks, you will receive the help of an AI assistant. The AI has access to the same source image as you do, and will provide a suggestion on the decision to be made. However, the AI might make mistakes, and the ultimate decision is your responsability. You are free to take into account the AI's prediction or not. In addition, you will have access to an explanation of the AI's prediction. It will highlight areas of the image which were important for the prediction. Red areas highlight zones which were leaning towards the decision YES, and blue areas highlight zones which were leaning towards the decision NO.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions
